scope: Every recorded difficult pair in the 27 development criteria, both directions, no correctness selection; all 96 attention heads and all 6 MLP outputs.
measurements: Gradient times paired activation difference; direct paired activation replacement for every component; native, identity and complete-restoration checks.
selection: Report every component. Any ranking is exploratory. No subsequent model selection or change to formal hypotheses.
role: Development analysis, executed after the conditional formal study and fixed path replay. No original formal data are read by this script.
